verdict.rationale: Cline's docs let you bring your own keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and others, run local models via Ollama or LM Studio, or pick from models through the Cline provider. You can also set separate models for Plan and Act modes and switch providers at any time. Community users confirm this in practice: one runs Gemini 2.5 rather than being limited to Anthropic, and another found local models worked well, though a third says Ollama works poorly with most models. Missing for 10: a documented complete provider list and step-by-step docs for switching models mid-session.
